svg.text: Connect smart plugs (Tasmota or Home Assistant) to automate power control and track energy.
Keep queued prints and AMS drying out of the hours your electricity costs more.
The queue holds jobs that would start during peak hours.
Don't start a print during peak hours
A print that starts before peak hours may run into them.
Only start a print that will finish before peak hours
Uses the slicer estimate plus a margin. Prints too long for any gap still run off-peak.
Scheduled, queue and humidity-triggered drying wait until peak hours end.
Stop drying when peak hours begin
Drying that's running stops, and the rest runs afterward.
